response.text: {"title": "Our approach", "text": "We meet the proposal requirements by sending the proposal by e-mail to the Trust's office as one document of no more than 15 pages by 17:00 GMT on 2027-02-12, keeping all personal data in the United Kingdom, and achieving system go-live by 2027-06-30 [APP-001]. We hold a record for each donor with their contact details and gift history, and record each donor's consent to be contacted by e-mail, by post and by telephone, with the date the consent was given [APP-002]. We record the hours each volunteer gives to each club and send each volunteer a reminder two days before every session they are booked on [APP-003]. We train the Trust's staff before the system goes live [APP-004]. We import the Trust's existing donor spreadsheet without manual retyping as part of the implementation option [APP-005].", "cited_ids": ["APP-001", "APP-002", "APP-003", "APP-004", "APP-005"]}
